topic: assistant-exploration-api round-1 security and performance fixes
lesson: Two more verified defects from the round-1 security and performance lenses, both confirmed in the code. (1) SECURITY, exploration-audit.filter.ts:25-26: the refusal record derives BOTH its resource and its action from request.originalUrl, which in Express carries the query string. It is wrong in both directions - a request to /api/saved?x=/api/pins is audited as resource 'pins' (attacker-forgeable audit identity), and a legitimate /api/pins/reorder?foo=1 fails url.endsWith('/reorder') and is audited as 'update_view'. Classify from the matched route instead (request.route?.path with baseUrl, or the path with the query stripped), never from attacker-controlled text, and cover both cases with a test. (2) PERFORMANCE, saved.service.ts:52: listing awaits one refusal-audit INSERT per refused row inside a for loop, so a caller whose grant was revoked pays a serial round trip per saved query. Write the refusals in ONE batched insert - fail-closed is preserved because a failed batch still aborts the listing, and it must stay fail-closed.
